authority: Root-directed implementation of the Figure4 brief; primary negative sign and minimum3 matched f agreed before predictor correlations were inspected.
primary_outcome: log(large-cell persistence time / small-cell persistence time), only when both direct persistence-time estimates are resolved under the declared finite-horizon gate.
separate_sensitivity_outcome: log large/small Dtheta-derived mobility-proxy persistence ratio under the already declared E0 estimator; never substituted for direct tau in the primary table or criterion.
condition_join: Same model, forcing family, native input fraction and analysis view. Match smallest and largest retained size labels. Keep seed-level A5 rows and condition-level uncertainty separate.

forced_views.primary: Exclude a model/f condition when either joined small or large state is forced under the canonical declared Figure4 gate.
forced_views.sensitivity: Include forced states, explicitly labeled; do not use this view to rescue the primary criterion.

within_model_correlations.features: Every declared A5 statistic in small cells, large cells and their large/small quotient; native dimensions remain within model.
within_model_correlations.estimator: Spearman rank correlation against log persistence ratio across matched input fractions f. At least3 usable distinct f and nonzero variation in x and y required.
within_model_correlations.zero_denominator: The large/small feature quotient is unavailable when the small feature is zero or unavailable. Do not add a pseudocount. A zero numerator over a positive denominator is the valid ratio0.
within_model_correlations.censoring: Unresolved lifetime medians, unresolved direct persistence ratios and unscorable takeover probabilities remain unavailable; no cap-value replacement.

cross_model_analysis.predictors: Only dimensionless within-model large/small feature quotients. Never pool absolute native times, lengths or rates across models.
cross_model_analysis.correlation_threshold: Pooled Spearman <= -0.6, with the declared direct, nonforced primary outcome. Report both predeclared features, not only the best result.
cross_model_analysis.unequal_model_coverage: Retain all joined condition points and report each model's point count. Do not manufacture unavailable Goryachev or other folds.
cross_model_analysis.other_features: Exploratory only. Their training-sign transfer is reported separately and cannot select or replace a primary H2 predictor.

leave_one_model_out.training: For each held-out model, pool only the other models' valid size-quotient points. Require at least3 distinct matched f values, at least3 points, and nonconstant predictor and outcome.
leave_one_model_out.held_out: Use only the held-out model's valid size-quotient points. Require at least3 distinct matched f values, at least3 points, and nonconstant predictor and outcome.
leave_one_model_out.primary_success: Training Spearman <0 and held-out Spearman <0. Zero correlation is a failure. Constant/insufficient/censored-only data are unavailable, not successful.
leave_one_model_out.exploratory_success: Nonzero training and held-out Spearman have the same sign; retain their signs, sample counts and unavailable reasons. No sign chosen after looking at the held-out model.
leave_one_model_out.denominator: Exactly4 planned folds. Unavailable folds count as not successful for the >=3/4 criterion; report them explicitly.
leave_one_model_out.interpretation: Sign-transfer validation, not a fitted quantitative time predictor or a causal test.

H2_A6_support: At least one of the two predeclared primary features satisfies pooled Spearman<=-0.6 and>=3 successful of4 planned LOMO folds. Report every primary feature and every fold; combine with the separately declared per-model H2 condition only in the root hypothesis assessment.
sensitivity_views: Dtheta-proxy outcome separate from direct tau
numerical_conventions: A vector is constant when its range is <=1e-12 times max(1,max absolute value). Rank correlations with absolute value<=1e-12 count as zero for sign transfer.
outcome_coverage: Direct tau requires both statuses resolved, positive finite ratio and the canonical evaluable/coverage gate. The separate Dtheta proxy requires a positive finite proxy and valid-bootstrap fraction>=0.5.
rank_uncertainty_scope: Correlations concern declared condition means over the designed f grid. Retain seed-level feature CIs and outcome ratio CIs; do not invent an independent-condition bootstrap or claim new seed-level correlation uncertainty from marginal CIs.
temporary_measurement_hold: Root audit found pairwise wins against the previous dominant without global dominance among qualified regions. Until strict two-frame global tracking is replayed, takeover-related predictor rows remain explicitly pending/unavailable; other statistics and predeclared primary signs/criteria are unchanged. This audit hold precedes accepted A6 correlations.
